name: Flying Sword Strike (Phi Kiếm Trảm)
rule: The sword leaves the hand and cuts: a plain quick Physical hit.

name: Seal Slam (Ấn Áp)
rule: The seal grows and falls: a slow, heavy Physical hit.

name: Gourd Spout (Hồ Lô Phún)
rule: The gourd spits what it holds: a plain Physical hit.

name: Fan Gust (Phiến Phong)
rule: One sweep of the fan: a plain Physical hit.

name: Needle Rain (Châm Vũ)
rule: A spray of needles: a cheap, quick Physical hit.

name: Mountain Cleave (Khai Sơn Phủ)
rule: The axe comes down once: a slow, heavy Physical hit.

name: Coin Shot (Tiền Tiêu Kích)
rule: A flicked coin: a cheap, quick Physical hit with the Metal tag.

name: String Cut (Cầm Huyền Trảm)
rule: One plucked string sends a blade of sound: a plain Force hit.

name: Anchor Drop (Mao Trầm)
rule: The anchor drops on its chain: the slowest, heaviest Physical hit of the common arts.
